settings.heading: Why This is So Effective
settings.text:
This weight loss program is designed to reset your relationship with food, helping you reach your overall health goals in a quick, sustainable way.

  1. The Skinny Bundle is packed with nutrition that is lacking in most diets. When your body doesn’t get enough of the right nutrients (found in plants) it holds onto excess weight and body fat. Once you start flooding your body with highly absorbable nutrients from the cold-pressed detox juices and weight loss smoothies, your body will think the "famine" is over and you’ll start dropping pounds and inches effortlessly. 
  2. The Skinny Bundle resets your diet and taste buds. Following this plan gives you a clean break from ultra-processed foods and helps you start cleaner eating habits. Starting with a juice cleanse and then continuing with a system that includes daily juices, nutrient-packed smoothies, and balanced meals, your palate naturally begins to prefer fresh, whole foods over junk foods.
  3. You can eat…a LOT. This is reset without restriction. The Skinny Bundle teaches you the healthy way to eat for weight loss that’s both satisfying and sustainable. You’ll get clear guidelines for meal planning, healthy snacks, and eating out, plus plenty of flexibility so you never have to feel hungry or restricted.
  4. You can maintain your workout routine after you cleanse. During the Skinny Cleanse®, limit activity to light exercise like walking, stretching or core work. The Skinny Method™ that follows your cleanse is designed to fuel your body with the nutrients it needs for both weight loss AND activity. You’ll be able to eat balanced meals, get enough calories to keep your energy up, and maintain (or even improve) your performance—without hitting a plateau.
  5. Convenience is the key to making this plan fit your life. The Skinny Bundle works for even the busiest schedule. With ready-to-drink juices and smoothies, easy-to-follow meal guidelines, and no complicated prep required, it’s simple to stick with. Everything is designed so you can succeed whether you’re at home, at work, or on the go.

settings.heading: Health Benefits
settings.text:
You’ll experience a full body reset in just a few days with the Skinny Cleanse® by drinking cold-pressed vegetable juices and fruit juices that are packed with vitamins, minerals, enzymes, antioxidants, and anti-inflammatory plant compounds.

The Skinny Cleanse®:

  • Supports healthy weight loss and weight management.
  • Detoxifies your body.
  • Eliminates unhealthy cravings...especially for sugar.
  • Increases energy levels naturally.
  • Boosts your immune system and reduces inflammation.

For this weight loss to be truly sustainable it needs to be 3 things:

  1. Delicious
  2. Easy to maintain
  3. Flexible for real life

This is why The Skinny Method™ is so important to your long-term success. This system teaches lifestyle changes that can be adaptable for any situation, with the help of delicious, ready-made juices and smoothies.

The Skinny Method™ helps you:

  • Lose weight consistently without dieting or deprivation.
  • Feel energized, satisfied, and in control of your eating habits.
  • Improve your gut health and lessen bloating.
  • Build healthy habits that actually last.

This program is NOT intended to be low calorie or portion-controlled, it is meant to teach you how to eat the RIGHT calories without restriction so you are able to form a truly healthy diet for the long-term.

settings.heading: A Typical Day on the Skinny Cleanse®
settings.text:
You’ll receive 6 juices for each day of your Skinny Cleanse®. We recommend starting around 8am and drinking one bottle at least every 2 hours, finishing the last juice at 6pm. 

Wake up & drink a large glass of water, have your coffee (if desired), and some fresh fruit.

8am: Sweet Greens - for daily detox

10am: Citrus Carrot - for stronger immunity

12 noon: Tarte Greens - for better gut health

2pm: Sweet Roots - for increased energy

4pm: Sweet Greens - for daily detox

6pm: Cool Greens - for better digestion/less bloating

This order of juices above is recommended, but you will still experience the same benefits regardless of the order in which you drink each flavor. If you wait too long between juices, you can run the risk of becoming too hungry.

Eating

Eat as much fresh fruit and vegetables as you desire throughout each day- either with your juices or in between. This includes baked, dry-roasted, or steamed potatoes. Instead of using oil or fats like butter on the potatoes, you can use lemon juice, salt, pepper, or any other fresh herbs and spices you like. 

Your Cleanse Guide includes a complete list of cleanse-approved foods and a recipe for a Hearty Vegetable Soup that you can enjoy without restriction during your cleanse.

Coffee

We recommend that you drink your coffee either black or with a low fat plant-milk like oatmilk. If you want to sweeten it, use honey. Adding sugar and creamer will defeat the purpose of doing a juice cleanse. 

Drinking Water

Even though these healthy juices are very hydrating, we strongly recommend drinking water throughout the day, ideally one glass between every bottle of juice. Water helps your body to flush out toxins more efficiently.

Exercise

This cleanse doesn’t provide enough calories to sustain intense workouts.  Even if you eat extra calories, it is best to limit your physical activities to walking, stretching, gentle yoga, and core work. 

Sleep

Sleep is just as important to weight loss as what you eat. Your body will release more weight if you get good sleep. We recommend at least 7-9 hours each night.

settings.heading: A Typical Day on the Skinny Method™
settings.text:
The Skinny Method™ gives you the freedom to eat satisfying meals, while strategically incorporating juices and smoothies that flood your body with nutrients.

  • Breakfast: Drink 1 green juice and eat all the fruit you want (you can’t overdo it).
  • Lunch: Drink 1 meal replacement smoothie.
  • Before Dinner: Drink 1 delicious Skinny Boost™ shot.
  • Dinner: Enjoy a balanced, clean dinner including lean protein, vegetables, and whole grains or potatoes.

Snacks

Included with your program are guidelines for snack ideas or meal additions that you can eat without restriction. This method teaches you how to eat both snacks and meals from “light to heavy” which eliminates bloating and helps you reach a healthy weight more effectively.

Coffee

We recommend that you drink your coffee either black or with a low fat plant-milk like oatmilk. If you want to sweeten it, use honey. Adding sugar and creamer will defeat the purpose of starting cleaner eating habits.

Drinking Water

Even though you’ll be drinking juices and smoothies that are hydrating, we strongly recommend drinking water throughout the day. Water helps your body to flush out toxins more efficiently.

Nutritionist Tip: The best way to tell if you are fully hydrated is if your urine is clear. If it isn’t, you need to drink more water.

Exercise

This system is designed to allow you to keep your normal workout routine. There is plenty of flexibility to add in more calories or protein, if needed.

Sleep

Sleep is just as important to weight loss as what you eat. Your body will release more weight if you get good sleep. We recommend at least 7-9 hours each night.

I’ve been a Holistic Nutritionist since 2008, helping hundreds of clients lose weight and reverse poor health - all without counting calories or feeling deprived.

After struggling with my own weight for over 10 years, I learned that I didn’t need a “diet” at all.  I just needed to learn the right way to eat.

Long-term restrictive behaviors only lead to inevitable frustration and failure - not to mention damaging a woman’s hormones and metabolism.
